page.overview:
Who is Bruno Bucciarati?

Bruno Bucciarati (ブローノ・ブチャラティ Burōno Bucharati) written as Bruno Bucellati in the novel is an incarnate of Bruno Bucciarati from the 37th universe, and a major ally featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He wields the Stand, Stepmom, and is a member of Passione.

Category:Male Characters Category:Characters Category:Living Characters Category:Living Characters in Light Novels Category:Stand Users Category:37th Universe Characters Category:Main Allies Category:Citations needed

Also known as: Bucciarati, Bruno Buccellati.
